texts.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ Mining Station in orbit of an astronomical object with a £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resource. These rare materials have immense strategic value.

Having located such a resource through Surveying, select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship, click on the [GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Station button and then on the appropriate astronomical object.
